steps: Heat EVOO in a wide cast iron on a high heat, then add capsicums and cook for 3 minutes.
Once the capsicums get a bit of color, add the red onion and let it soften, then add spices
Add in the cherry tomatoes and cook until the skin blisters and juice releases, about 5 minutes.
With the back of the spoon, press down on the tomatoes so the juice is released.
Add the tomato paste and harissa, then the water and allow to simmer for about 5 minutes.
Once the mixture thickens, create indents in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover with aluminium foil or a lid and allow eggs to cook, about 5 minutes.
Remove lid, sprinkle parsley over the top and serve. Best enjoyed straight from the pan with bread.

recipe_info.title: Shakshuka
recipe_info.intro: An inauthentic version of shakshuka that makes for a very quick weeknight meal or a tasty breakfast.
